senses.gloss: लोक-ईश-प्रभव- + अप्यय लोक-ईश-प्रभव- + अप्यय, adj. owing both origin and end to the guardians of the world, Man. 5, 97.
लोक- + अभिहार लोक- + अभिहार, m. lustration of arms.
लोक- + पाल लोक- + पाल, see s. v.

लोकपाल लोक-पाल, m.
 1. A king.
 2. The name of certain divinities, guardians of the world, as Indra, Soma, etc.; cf. a list of them in Wilson's Specimens of the Theatre of the Hindus, i. 2. ed. 219, n. ad Vikr. d. 36.
लोक- + पितामह लोक- + पितामह, m. the great forefather of mankind.
लोक- + प्रवाद लोक- + प्रवाद, m. common report or saying, Lass. 12, 13.

लोक- + यात्रा लोक- + यात्रा, f. 1. the way of the world, Mālav. 68, 17. 2. worldly affairs, domestic affairs, Man. 9, 27. 3. traffic, intercourse, Hit. i. d. 104, M.M. 4. the life of the world, Bhāg. P. 3, 9, 20.
लोक- + रञ्जन लोक- + रञ्जन, n. gaining public confidence.

लोक् लोक्, i. 1, Ātm., and i. 10, Par. (probably a denomin. derived from लोक),
 1. To see.
 2. i. 10, † To shine, to speak.
 --With the prep. अव अव, i. 1 and 10,
 1. To see, Hit. 15, 2, M.M.; to look, Hit. 85, 15; to regard, Vikr. 3, 6; to see to, Śāk. 3, 6; to watch, Pañc. 249, 4.
 2. To perceive, Vikr. 21, 3; Lass. 9, 16.
 3. To review (an army), Hit. 94, 8.
 --With समव सम्-अव, i. 10, To inspect, Śāk. d. 13.
 --With आ [] आ, i. 1 and 10,
 1. To look out, MBh. 4, 250.
 2. To regard, Vikr. d. 81; to see, Pañc. i. d. 21; to inspect, to view, MBh. 3, 11024.
 3. To perceive, MBh. 2, 1817.
 4. To consider, Man. 8, 126. सालोकित, n. Look, eye, Mālat. 16, 8.
 --With समा सम्-आ,
 1. To look at, MBh. 2, 775.
 2. To acknowledge, Pañc. pr. d. 3.
 --With वि वि, i. 10, To see, Vikr. 8, 17; to regard, 12, 20; Utt. Rāmac. 47, 8. विलोक्य,
 1. Regarding, i. e. to, Vikr. 40, 1; to view, Rām. 1, 44, 19.
 2. To take a view of, Pañc. 46, 7.
 3. To look over, Man. 8, 239.
 4. To perceive, 2, 9.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. विलोकित, n. Seeing, Śāk. d. 36.
 --With प्रवि प्र-वि, To look forward, Rām. 1, 9, 59. Cf. रुच्.

लोक लोक, i. e. लोच्, or रुच्, + अ (with ल् for र्, cf. रुच्), m.
 1. Seeing, sight.
 2. The world, the universe, Chr. 34, 8.
 3. A world, a division of the universe, Vikr. 86, 8 (मध्यम, The middle world, i. e. the earth).
 4. Man, mankind.
 5. Men. people, sing. and pl., Daśak. in Chr. 183, 13; Pañc. i. d. 19; 256, 24; Bhartṛ. 2, 52.
 --Comp.
लोकालोक लोकालोक, i. e. लोक-अ-, m. a mountainous belt bounding the world.
लोकायत लोकायत, i. e. लोक-आ-यत (vb. यम्?), n. The system of atheistical philosophy, taught by चार्वाक.
लोकायतिक लोकायतिक, लोकायत + इक, m. A follower of the Cārvāka system (see the last)
लोक- + वाद लोक- + वाद, m. rumour, Daśak. in Chr. 185, 14.
लोक- + वाह्य लोक- + वाह्य, m. an outcaste.
लोक-विश्रुति लोक-विश्रुति, f. 1. fame. 2. unfounded rumour.
